_note: rav4-2025: converted from Toyota Canada's official 2025 RAV4 LE AWD maintenance schedule (km), checked by a second read (M5b). Time limits: Toyota Canada's owner's supplement (p. 25) says maintenance is required every 6 months or 8,000 km, whichever occurs first; items done every N visits get N x 6 months. Items with 'partOf' have no interval of their own: they are done or inspected at that item's visit. rav4-hybrid-2026: still a SAMPLE schedule.

source.label: Toyota Canada: Maintenance Schedule, 2025 RAV4 LE AWD

timeSource.label: Toyota Canada: 2025 Owner's Manual Supplement, p. 25 (every 6 months or 8,000 km)

items.name: Service visit (inspection and tire rotation)
items.includes: Lights, horn and wipers; tire tread and damage; wheels off to inspect brake pads, rotors and lines; rotate tires; remove and inspect cabin and engine air filters; check for fluid leaks; reset the maintenance reminder.

items.name: Detailed inspection: measure brakes, 12-volt battery check
items.includes: Service #3: remove calipers and measure brake pads and rotors; 12-volt battery health check; valve clearance; fuel system and cooler lines.

items.name: Tire rotation
items.note: Toyota rotates the tires at every service visit.

items.name: Cabin air filter
items.note: Toyota Canada's schedule has no set replacement interval for the cabin air filter: it is removed and inspected at every service visit and replaced only if found dirty or damaged.

items.name: Engine air filter
items.note: Toyota Canada's schedule has no set replacement interval for the engine air filter: it is removed and inspected at every service visit and replaced only if found dirty or damaged.

items.name: Brake pads
items.note: Brakes are inspected with the wheels off at every service visit and measured every 32,000 km. Pads are replaced when worn, not at a set interval.

items.name: Tighten propeller shaft bolts (AWD)
items.note: Done at the same visits as the oil change.

items.name: Inspect block heater (if equipped)
items.note: Done at the same visits as the oil change.
